macros.name: rcDecimalSign
macros.doc: The decimal sign can be changed with the commands \rcDecimalSign, affecting both input and output.

macros.name: rcDecimalSignInput
macros.doc: The macros \rcDecimalSignInput and \rcDecimalSignOutput can be used to change the default use of a comma as the decimal sign. This can be done separately for input and output.

macros.name: rcDecimalSignOutput
macros.doc: The macros \rcDecimalSignInput and \rcDecimalSignOutput can be used to change the default use of a comma as the decimal sign. This can be done separately for input and output.

macros.name: rcRoundingfalse
macros.doc: Numbers are not rounded or altered in any way; trailing zeros are not appended.
